label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: [name] banner stays open and its [name] and Agree buttons are not reachable early in the tab order; the only early Close banner button closed the shipping promo bar, not the cookie banner, so I could not decline cookies by keyboard
Skip link does not move focus into the page content visibly and keyboard focus is lost to the top of the page after every page load, forcing many Tab presses through the large header menu

About 25 Tab presses before reaching Select size: eight unnamed gallery buttons that change the image on focus, several unnamed colour links, and the product options are far from the top, with no way to jump to the buy area
Choosing a size gave no spoken or visible confirmation and the Cart count stayed at 0; a length choice then appeared with no announcement, so I was unsure whether the size was accepted

After Add to cart focus jumped back to the top of the page with no message; the cart count only changed to 1 later, and no cart panel or checkout link could be reached, so I could not proceed to checkout
